# Safety and evidence sources

These references constrain wording and safety boundaries; they are not used to
claim clinical efficacy for the product.

- NHS, pelvic-floor exercises and normal breathing:
  https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/urinary-incontinence/10-ways-to-stop-leaks/
- NHS, treatment context for pelvic-floor training:
  https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/urinary-incontinence/treatment/
- Royal Brompton and Harefield NHS, progressive muscle relaxation:
  https://www.rbht.nhs.uk/our-services/clinical_support/rehabilitation-and-therapies/psychological-medicine/relaxation-exercises
- Guy's and St Thomas' NHS, body scan practice:
  https://www.guysandstthomas.nhs.uk/health-information/mindfulness-based-stress-reduction-mbsr/mbsr-exercises
- NHS, gentle flexibility and stop-if-pain framing:
  https://www.nhs.uk/live-well/exercise/flexibility-exercises/
- Frimley Health NHS, head, neck and shoulder stretches:
  https://www.fhft.nhs.uk/patients-and-visitors/patient-information-library/head-neck-and-shoulder-stretches
- NCCIH, yoga safety and the need to avoid extreme practice for beginners:
  https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/yoga-effectiveness-and-safety
- PubMed, small exploratory facial-exercise pilot (not a basis for a broad
  rejuvenation claim): https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29299598/

## Local §38 research boundary

The existing Denis/Claude image-modifier prototype was inspected only to map
the requested effect inventory. It is not a redistributable dependency and no
historical WireChanger file or asset is included. Exact local paths, hashes,
clean-room boundary and the still-missing background-license manifest are in
`IMAGE_EFFECTS_PROVENANCE.md`.

The Feldenkrais-informed, Schultz-informed and anapanasati entries use original
neutral microcopy and make no clinical or performance claim. They implement the
solo-only product classification from §35.5; they do not claim equivalence to a
course, teacher or therapeutic protocol.
